characters.name: Sen Con
characters.description: A tiny lotus-bud sprite with a round pink bud as a hat, a soft cream face, two small green leaf arms and short stubby legs.
characters.identity_notes: Pink lotus bud hat with three visible petals on top; small black dot eyes; rosy round cheeks; two green leaf hands; same proportions on every sticker. a tapered brush line, thin at the ends; completely flat colour with no shading.
characters.rights_notes: Nhân vật gốc của Restick, không dựa trên nhân vật có bản quyền.

characters.name: Trâu Con
characters.description: A round chubby water buffalo calf with short swept-back horns, a grey body and a light belly, smiling softly.
characters.identity_notes: Short swept-back horns; a small red cloth tied around the neck; a white tuft on the forehead; round belly; same colours on every sticker. a uniform ink line of constant weight.

characters.name: Tô Phở
characters.description: A walking bowl of phở with a tiny face on the broth, a green onion tuft on top and chopsticks for arms.
characters.identity_notes: A white bowl with a thin blue rim; a green onion tuft on top; wooden chopsticks as arms; small steam curl above; face stays on the broth. a uniform ink line of constant weight.

characters.name: Ổ Bánh Mì
characters.description: A cheerful baguette character with a golden crust, a smiling face and visible pickled filling at one end.
characters.identity_notes: A golden brown crust with diagonal slashes; a cheerful smile; green cilantro and orange pickled carrot peeking out one end; same size and shape on every sticker. a uniform ink line of constant weight.

characters.name: Nón Lá
characters.description: A small child hidden under an oversized conical hat, with only a wide smile and rosy cheeks visible.
characters.identity_notes: A large woven conical hat that covers the eyes; a wide smile and rosy cheeks; a red silk chin strap; a plain cream tunic. a uniform ink line of constant weight.

characters.description: A baby Vietnamese dragon with a soft sage-green body, a small golden mane and gentle S-curved posture, no wings.

characters.name: Cá Chép Nhí
characters.description: A plump orange carp with big round eyes, long whiskers, translucent fins and a small tail.
characters.identity_notes: Plump orange body; two long thin whiskers; translucent fins; a small white spot on the forehead; big round eyes. a uniform ink line of constant weight; two-step cel shading.

characters.name: Cậu Cóc
characters.description: A round green toad with warty skin, wide mouth, a tiny straw hat and a calm confident expression.
characters.identity_notes: A green round body with warty bumps; a small straw hat; a wide calm mouth; gold ringed eyes; upright seated posture. a uniform ink line of constant weight.
characters.rights_notes: Nhân vật gốc của Restick, lấy cảm hứng từ truyện dân gian.

characters.name: Chú Phin
characters.description: A small steel phin coffee filter with tiny arms and legs, a lid hat and a drop of coffee on its head.
characters.identity_notes: Steel phin body with a lid as a hat; a single drop of dark coffee on top; thin arms and legs; two small dot eyes; a round body. a uniform ink line of constant weight.
